hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a convex, symmetric effect of x4: the target rises with |x4| more than predicted, so residuals are positive at large |x4| and negative near x4 = 0.
rationale: Six of the seven positive residuals (+0.22) have |x4| near or above 0.94 with both signs (-1.416, +2.375, +1.151), while the negative residuals cluster at small |x4| (0.103, 0.164). The overlap around |x4| of about 0.7 (rows 2 and 6) is consistent with noise or a smooth quadratic rather than a sharp threshold.
